interface.defaultPrompt: Help me find and apply the right agent skills for my task using the Antigravity Awesome Skills collection.
interface.longDescription: A skills-focused companion for navigating the Antigravity Awesome Skills collection. Helps map tasks to relevant skills, plan skill-driven workflows, assess risks and assumptions, and turn a chosen skill into actionable steps. The upstream collection and its installer remain in the source repository.

name: antigravity-awesome-skills
description: Discover, assess, select, and apply agent skills from the Antigravity Awesome Skills collection.
